test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Solanum lycopersicum L. is the scientific name of which of the following highly consumed vegetables?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tomato.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **
**__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​__Tomato**, (Solanum Lycopersicum),** a flowering plant of the nightshade family (Solanaceae), is cultivated extensively for its edible fruits.
 
• Labeled as a vegetable for nutritional purposes, tomatoes are a good source of **vitamin C and the phytochemical lycopene.**
 
• Root decoction is ingested for relief from tooth pain. Tomatoes are rich in lycopene, a substance with beneficial effects on the heart and prostate. It is also used for rheumatism and headaches. Tomato fruits are consumed in many various ways and forms, either raw or cooked.
 
• Tomato, (Solanum Lycopersicum), a flowering plant of the nightshade family (Solanaceae)**, is cultivated extensively for its edible fruits.​
